name: Employees' Pension Scheme
briefDescription: Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS-95) gives EPF members with 10+ years of service a monthly pension from age 58 — calculated as (Pensionable Salary × Pensionable Service) ÷ 70 — plus family pension and disability pension.
descriptionMd:
The Employees' Pension Scheme 1995 (EPS-95), administered by the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) under the Ministry of Labour & Employment, is a defined-benefit pension for workers in the organised sector. Every employee covered under the Employees' Provident Fund Act, 1952 automatically becomes an EPS member.

Every month, **8.33% of the employer's 12% EPF contribution** goes into EPS rather than the provident fund. The government also contributes **1.16% of wages** (on the ₹15,000 wage ceiling) to EPS. When a member retires, they receive a monthly pension for life — and after their death, their spouse and children continue to receive family pension.
benefitsMd:
| Pension Type | Condition | Rate |
|-------------|-----------|------|
| **Superannuation Pension** | Retire at 58 with ≥10 years service | (Pensionable Salary × Pensionable Service) ÷ 70 |
| **Early Pension** | Age 50–58, ≥10 years service | Superannuation Pension reduced by 4% per year before 58 |
| **Disability Pension** | Permanent total disablement during service | 50% of Pensionable Salary (min ₹250/month) |
| **Widow's / Widower's Pension** | On member's death | 50% of member's pension (min ₹1,000/month) |
| **Children's Pension** | Up to 2 children under 25 | 25% of widow pension per child |
| **Orphan Pension** | Both parents dead | 75% of widow pension per child (up to 2 children) |

**Pensionable Salary** = average monthly pay drawn during the last 60 months before exit (capped at ₹15,000 unless higher wages were contributed on).
**Pensionable Service** = actual service years (plus 2 bonus years if service ≥20 years).
eligibilityMd:
- Must be a **member of the EPF Scheme 1952** (i.e., employed in an establishment covered under the EPF & MP Act).
- Monthly wage must not exceed **₹15,000** at the time of joining (those above this can join voluntarily).
- Must have completed **10 years of contributory membership** in EPS to receive monthly pension.
- Members with less than 10 years of service can withdraw the **EPS corpus** as a lump sum instead of a pension.
exclusionsMd:
- Members who exit EPS with **less than 10 years of service** are not entitled to a monthly pension — they receive a withdrawal benefit (lump sum).
- Members who withdraw their EPS corpus before completing 10 years lose eligibility for monthly pension.
applicationMd:
**To activate your UAN (before retirement):**
**Step 1:** Visit the EPFO Unified Portal at [unifiedportal-emp.epfindia.gov.in](https://unifiedportal-emp.epfindia.gov.in/) → click 'For Employees' → 'Activate UAN'.
**Step 2:** Enter your UAN (or Member ID), Aadhaar, name, date of birth and mobile → get OTP → activate.

**To claim EPS pension (on retirement at 58+):**
**Step 1:** Log in to the EPFO Member Portal with your UAN and password.
**Step 2:** Go to **'Online Services' → 'Claim (Form-31, 19 & 10C)'**.
**Step 3:** Verify your bank account and Aadhaar KYC.
**Step 4:** Choose **'Full EPF Settlement' or 'Pension Withdrawal (Form 10C)'** depending on whether you're claiming pension or lump sum.
**Step 5:** Submit the online claim; your employer verifies it and EPFO processes the pension or settlement.
